note: Fixed corpus for the radar decode regression harness (dev-only). Each volume is a committed .V06 under Assets/RadarCorpus/, replayed through the REAL decode path (radar-decode.js decodeAndBuild) in the Validate card. TWO guards, both exact because the corpus is fixed and the decode deterministic: (1) VELOCITY DEALIAS over-unfold ratio (hi/total, |v|>55 m/s) vs 'expectedPct' + 'tolerancePct' (the KTLX-3x-regression guard); (2) DUAL-POL DECODER means (optional 'dualPol' {cc,zdr,sw}) — the direct-read CC/ZDR/SW moments decode deterministically, so their mean is a stable fingerprint that a decoder scale/offset regression shifts (guard: |actual mean - baseline| > ~0.15). To score a volume WITHOUT committing it, drop the .V06 into Assets/RadarCorpus/ and list it here by filename, then just don't 'git add' it. Baselines set 2026-08-03: over-unfold refreshed after the EDGE_SKIP fix (all ~0%); dualPol means measured in-app + cross-checked gate-for-gate vs Py-ART (tools/dualpol_check.py). See docs/radar-validation.md.
